dimensions.rationale: Full table structure is present: <caption> describes the table's purpose, <thead> and <tbody> group rows, and every header cell uses <th scope='col'>. Status values ('Active', 'On Leave', 'Departed') are conveyed as text, not colour alone. No layout misuse of <table>.

All interactive controls are native elements: <button> for Download CSV, <select> for filters, <input type='text'> for search, and <a> elements for pagination. The only notable miss is that start dates (e.g., '2021-03-15') are plain text rather than <time datetime='...'> elements, which would be the more precise semantic choice.

All three inputs (search, department, status) have associated <label> elements, and the controls are grouped inside a <form> satisfying the 'form or <search>' requirement. However, there is no <fieldset>/<legend> grouping the filter controls as a related set, which would strengthen the semantic grouping of the filter UI.

<nav aria-label='Pagination'> is correctly labelled, and aria-current='page' is applied to the active page link. No redundant ARIA roles are added to semantic elements, and no ARIA is used to compensate for non-semantic markup.

summary: The output is strong overall. Table semantics are complete (caption, thead, tbody, th scope='col', text-based status). All form controls have labels and live inside a <form>. ARIA usage is disciplined: pagination nav is labelled and aria-current='page' is present. Minor deductions: start dates lack <time datetime> wrappers (element_choice −1) and the filter controls are not grouped with <fieldset>/<legend> (form_semantics −1).
